description: Source code implementing Zigbee bridge cluster functionalities, including creation, configuration, command handling, and alarm processing for Zigbee devices.

classes.name: BridgeCluster
classes.description: Structure representing a Zigbee bridge cluster with callback functions and context.

methods.name: bridgeClusterCreate
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new BridgeCluster instance with provided callbacks and context.

methods.name: bridgeClusterRefresh
methods.description: Sends a command to refresh the bridge cluster.

methods.name: bridgeClusterStartConfiguration
methods.description: Sends a command to start configuration on the bridge cluster.

methods.name: bridgeClusterStopConfiguration
methods.description: Sends a command to stop configuration on the bridge cluster.

methods.name: bridgeClusterReset
methods.description: Sends a reset command to the bridge cluster.
